title: Rejection probability of a nonadaptive tester
statement: Let $T$ be a randomized nonadaptive tester with a finite seed space, a probability law on its seeds, and a deterministic acceptance rule. For a function $f$ from its domain to its codomain, its rejection probability is one minus its acceptance probability.
